description: AIF-02A privacy and egress gate: design challenge and exact-diff review

phi_to_unqualified.instructions: PHI or another sensitive class could reach a provider that is not admitted for that class, purpose or retention.

criteria.true: Some path sends a sensitive class to an unqualified destination
criteria.false: Class ceiling, allowed providers, purpose and retention are all enforced

silent_cloud_fallback.instructions: A local-only payload could end up at a remote provider, including through a fallback after a local failure.

criteria.true: Local-only data can go remote, or a fallback can be silent
criteria.false: Local-only classes never go remote and fallbacks are explicit and denied

credential_egress.instructions: A credential, secret or credential-shaped value could leave in a payload.

criteria.false: Credentials are refused regardless of policy

value_leak_in_receipt.instructions: A receipt, log or decision record could contain a source value or a minimized value rather than only paths, classes and digests.

criteria.true: Values can appear in receipts or logs
criteria.false: Only paths, classes, transforms and digests appear

consent_bypass.instructions: Data requiring consent could be sent with missing, revoked or payload-supplied consent, or without a purpose.

criteria.true: Consent or purpose can be bypassed
criteria.false: Purpose is mandatory and consent is server-supplied and checked at server time

residual_risk.instructions: How much risk remains in this egress design?
